steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the base directory structure for Word Counter Pro using package name com.wordcounterpro.app.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing metadata configuration for packaging.

steps.title: Set Up Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle with Android SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and dependencies rules.

steps.title: Design App Layout UI
steps.description: Create a rich, single-screen UI layout in activity_main.xml featuring statistics grid, input field, keyword list, and action tools.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml specifying application name, main entry point, and light material theme.

steps.title: Implement Real-Time Analysis Logic
steps.description: Code the text parsing, syllable calculation, and readability index algorithms in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Keyword Density Analyzer
steps.description: Add sorting mechanism to map top recurring words without using external Java 8+ features.

steps.title: Implement Text Tools Actions
steps.description: Add copy, paste, clear, share, and find & replace functionalities within MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Case Conversion Features
steps.description: Integrate UPPERCASE, lowercase, sentence case, and title case helpers in the action panel.

steps.title: Configure App Theme Styles
steps.description: Utilize android:theme Theme.Material.Light dynamically for standard professional styling.

steps.title: Validate Code and Layout compatibility
steps.description: Confirm compilation properties and resources alignments for target SDK.

steps.title: Building Word Counter Pro
steps.description: Assemble application components into a production build using Gradle 8.5.
